items.title: 1- Determining the Active sites and Domains (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 1- Determining the Active sites and Domains: a main subheading of 7.1 Applications of structural biology, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 170-171.

blocks.text: Structural biologists proteins aur nucleic acids jaise macromolecules ki 3D structure maloom kar sakte hain. Is 3D structure se pata chalta hai ke active site aur alag alag domains kahan hain, un ki shakal kaisi hai aur un ke aas paas kya hai. Domain molecule ka woh alag hissa hai jo apna kaam khud karta hai. Misal: enzyme HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ki structure se us ke do domains pehchane gaye: polymerase domain (jo DNA banata hai) aur RNase H domain (jo RNA-DNA hybrid mein se RNA wali strand ko tod deta hai). In domains ki jagah aur shakal jaan kar aisi antiviral dawaein banai gayin jo seedha inhi ko nishana banati hain. Isi tarah serine proteases ki structure se un ki wazeh active site dikhti hai, jo peptide bonds todti hai.

blocks.alt: Proteins ki do satahi (surface) tasaweer. (a) HIV-1 reverse transcriptase: bara gehra neela jism jis par halke hare lobes hain aur us ke paar nucleic acid ka double helix para hai; ek gher kiya lobe Polymerase domain aur doosra Nuclease domain hai. (b) Serine protease: surmai (grey) gol satah jis par chhoti neeli-surkh jeb ghair kar Active site likhi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.1: (a) HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ki 3D banawat; (b) serine protease ki 3D banawat (kitab ki Figure 7.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Domain protein ka woh hissa hai jo apna alag kaam karta hai. HIV ke reverse transcriptase mein polymerase domain DNA banata hai aur nuclease (RNase H) domain RNA ko kaat-ta hai; dawaein inhi jagahon ko nishana banati hain. Serine protease mein active site woh chhoti jeb (pocket) hai jahan substrate judta hai.
